First-touch grading (triage seat): promoted to `pm:queue`, Task. Preferred shape is the card's cheaper variant if it prices out — derive the expiry probe from `packages/spec/src/**` source text, removing the built-spec dependency entirely; otherwise make `--require-stamp` imply a readable spec blob (or add the explicit flag and pass it in `ci.yml`) so a run that cannot re-check expiry fails instead of printing an `ℹ`. Not live today (verified reasoning in the body), so no priority label. Size/model suggestion: S–M, opus.
